cli.description: Tools for the content store (course/) of the trilingual Agentic Coding course.
cli.root_help: repository root to work on (default: this repository)
cli.validate_help: check the whole content store (CI runs this)
cli.stats_help: show the size of the course and the writing progress per language
cli.scaffold_help: create a lesson's file in every language folder, from course/data/sections.yaml
cli.fb_help: draft a Facebook post from a lesson
cli.post_lang_help: language of the post (default: the course's source language)
cli.out_help: write the post to this file instead of printing it
cli.fix_errors_first: The content store has errors. Run "python -m src.main validate", fix them, then try again.
cli.build_help: write every generated file: course homes, glossary pages, infographics
cli.build_check_help: exit with status 1 when a generated file is out of date
cli.export_help: save the course as HTML files that open offline, to share it without GitHub
cli.export_out_help: folder to write the HTML files to (default: outputs/html in the repository)

types.language_list: a list of language codes such as [vi, en, ja]

findings.encoding_invalid: {path}: the file is not valid UTF-8 text.
findings.field_unknown: {path}: unknown field "{field}" — a typo, or a value that YAML split in two?
findings.id_invalid: {path}: the id "{id}" may only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (for example: chatbot-to-agent).
findings.term_unknown: {path}: lesson "{lesson}" uses the glossary term "{term}", which course/data/glossary.yaml does not define.
findings.term_unused: {path}: the glossary term "{term}" is not used by any lesson.
findings.lesson_file_missing: {path}: missing. A started lesson needs a file in every language folder (python -m src.main scaffold <lesson-id> creates them).
findings.front_matter_missing: {path}: the file must start with a front matter block between two "---" lines.
findings.front_matter_mismatch: {path}: "{field}" is "{actual}", but the file's location says "{expected}".
findings.title_missing: {path}: the lesson title (a line starting with "# ") is missing.
findings.content_outside_section: {path}:{line}: text outside any section. Move it under a <!-- section: ... --> marker.
findings.section_marker_orphan: {path}:{line}: a section marker must be followed by a "## " heading.
findings.heading_without_marker: {path}:{line}: the heading "{heading}" has no <!-- section: ... --> marker above it.
findings.section_unknown: {path}: unknown section "{section}" (the list is in course/data/sections.yaml).
findings.section_duplicate: {path}: the section "{section}" appears more than once.
findings.section_order: {path}: the section "{section}" is out of order (course/data/sections.yaml sets the order).
findings.todo_left: {path}: the section "{section}" still contains a TODO placeholder.
findings.lesson_file_unknown: {path}: matches no lesson id in course/data/curriculum.yaml.
findings.language_bar: {path}: the line under the front matter must be the language bar: {expected}
findings.minimum_path_unknown: {path}: the minimum path lists {id}, which is not a lesson in the curriculum.
findings.minimum_path_track: {path}: {id} is on the minimum path, but its unit's track is {track}; the minimum path takes core lessons only.
findings.minimum_path_order: {path}: the minimum path lists {id} after {previous}, but the course teaches {id} first. Keep the course order.
findings.retired_in_use: {path}: {id} is retired but is still an id in the curriculum. A retired id is never used again.
findings.retired_target_unknown: {path}: {id} is retired into {into}, which is not a lesson in the curriculum.
findings.recap_diagram: {path}: the recap must show exactly one infographic from course/data/diagrams/ — it shows {images} image(s), {diagrams} of them infographics.
findings.recap_reused: {path}: the recap infographic {target} is also shown in another section. The recap sums up the whole lesson in a picture of its own.
findings.diagram_crowded: {path}: too much text to draw the {language} diagram without boxes overlapping. Shorten its captions or arrow labels, or use fewer steps.
findings.diagram_word_split: {path}: in the {language} diagram, a word is longer than its box and gets cut in two: {words}. Use a shorter word, or fewer boxes in that row.
findings.diagram_unknown: {path}: the image {target} is not a diagram in course/data/diagrams/.
findings.image_alt_missing: {path}: the image {target} needs alt text (what a reader who cannot see it is told).
findings.link_broken: {path}: the link {target} points to a file that does not exist.
findings.build_stale: {path}: out of date with course/data/ and the lessons. Run: python -m src.main build

validate.ok: Content store OK. Lesson files checked: {files}. Warnings: {warnings}.

stats.heading: {title} — roadmap {version}
stats.structure: Modules: {modules} · Units: {units} · Lessons: {lessons} · Total time: {minutes} min
stats.progress_line: {language}: done {done} · in review {review} · draft {draft} · skeleton {todo} · not started {missing} ({percent}% done)

scaffold.exists: Skipped {path}: it already exists, and nothing is overwritten.
scaffold.unknown_lesson: Unknown lesson id "{lesson}". The lesson ids are listed in course/curriculum.yaml.
scaffold.next: Next: write the {language} version first, then localize it into the other languages.

fb.not_started: Lesson "{lesson}" has no {language} file yet. Run: python -m src.main scaffold {lesson}
fb.not_ready: {path} has the status "{status}". Only lessons in review or done can become a post.
fb.review_warning: Note: {path} is still in review — read it once more before posting.

build.up_to_date: Generated files are up to date ({files}).

home.legend: Lessons with a link are ready to read; the others are being written.
home.minimum_intro: Start here: {lessons} lessons · {minutes} min, enough to give an AI agent real work and check the result yourself. They carry a ⭐ in the tables below; take the other lessons when you need them.

glossary.title: Glossary in Three Languages
glossary.intro: Each term is explained in English, with what it is called in Vietnamese and in Japanese.

export.open_hint: Double-click a file to open it in a browser; no internet needed. Keep the files in one folder so the 🌐 language links work; {combined} alone holds all three languages.
export.footer: Offline copy made on {date} · lessons ready: {ready} of {total}.
export.print_tip: Tip: to get a PDF, print this page (Ctrl+P, or ⌘+P on a Mac) and choose “Save as PDF”: the whole course in one file.
export.missing_dependency: export needs the markdown-it-py library. Install it with: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
